cases.situation: My manager Jordan messages me on the work chat on weekends with 'quick questions'. I want to stop answering until Monday without it hurting my review. A phone call for a real emergency is fine.
cases.reply: Hi Jordan, I want to be useful when you need me, and I also want to protect my weekends so I'm sharp on Monday. From now on I'll be offline on the work chat on Saturdays and Sundays and I'll pick everything up first thing Monday. If something is truly urgent, call my phone and I'll answer.
cases.note: The boundary is what you will do, with a real channel for emergencies, so it reads as reliable rather than unavailable.

cases.situation: 我妈每周六来我家帮忙，每次都把我的衣柜和厨房重新整理一遍，上周还扔了我囤的一些东西，我找了好几天。我很欢迎她每周来，但柜子和厨房我想自己管。以后她来，我想跟她一起去买菜做饭。
cases.reply: 妈，您每周六过来我特别高兴，也知道您是想帮我。以后我的衣柜和厨房我自己收拾，东西放哪儿我自己定。您来了，咱们一起去买菜、做顿饭，好好聊聊天。
cases.note: 说的是“我自己管”，不翻扔东西的旧账；她再动手整理，就笑着说一句“这个我自己来”，不加新理由。

cases.situation: Told my best friend I can't do 1am phone calls about her ex anymore and offered to call her on Saturday mornings instead. She replied 'wow, I thought you were my best friend, after everything I've done for you.'
cases.reply: I know you're upset, and I love you. I'm still here for you, just not at 1am. I'll call you Saturday morning.
cases.note: Pushback means repeat it shorter, with no new reasons. Then call on Saturday as promised.

cases.situation: Ma petite sœur Léa me demande de l'argent pour la troisième fois cette année, cette fois 400 euros pour son loyer. Je l'aime mais je ne veux plus prêter, les deux premières fois ne sont jamais revenues. Je suis prête à regarder son budget avec elle ce week-end.
cases.reply: Léa, je t'aime et je veux t'aider, vraiment. Mais je ne prête plus d'argent, à personne, c'est une décision ferme de mon côté. Par contre, si tu veux, on regarde ton budget ensemble ce week-end et on cherche ce qui peut se débloquer pour le loyer.
cases.note: Pas de reproche sur les deux prêts précédents : la limite porte sur ce que tu fais, et l'aide proposée est réelle. Si elle insiste, répète la même phrase, plus courte.

cases.situation: My mother-in-law, Linda, has a spare key and lets herself into our house 'just to drop things off', sometimes while we're still in bed. My husband agrees it has to stop. From now on we'll keep the door latched from the inside when we're home; she can text first or leave things on the porch bench, and she stays our emergency key holder. I want to text her kindly.
cases.reply: Hi Linda, we love having you close by. From now on we're going to keep the door latched from the inside when we're home, so the key won't open it. Text before you come over and we'll let you in, or leave things on the porch bench. You're still our emergency key holder.
cases.note: The boundary is what you will do with the door, not a rule for her. If she pushes back, repeat the same line shorter: text first and we'll open up.

cases.situation: 我是儿科医生。表嫂经常半夜在微信上发孩子的照片问我该吃什么药，这周已经问了三次。我想以后不在微信上看病了，但不想得罪亲戚。不知道去哪家医院、挂哪个号，我还是愿意帮她推荐。
cases.reply: 嫂子，孩子有事你第一个想到问我，我挺高兴的。想跟你说一下，以后我不在微信上看病了，隔着照片看不准，万一耽误了孩子我心里过不去。孩子不舒服就直接去医院挂儿科，如果不知道去哪家、挂哪个号，你随时问我，我帮你推荐。
cases.note: 边界说的是“我不在微信上看病”，是自己的做法，不是要求她别问；再问时重复同一句，不加新理由。

cases.situation: My boyfriend Josh and I moved in together in August. He wants to do something together every single evening and I'm running on empty; I want to keep Mondays and Wednesdays for myself. Nothing is wrong between us.
cases.reply: I love living with you, and I want to keep loving it. I need a couple of evenings a week that are just mine, because that's how I recharge, not because anything's wrong. I'm going to keep Mondays and Wednesdays for myself, and the other nights I'm all yours.
cases.note: State it as what you will do, with one reason; if he pushes, repeat the same sentence rather than adding new ones.

cases.situation: My dad keeps posting photos of my kids, 4 and 7, on his public social media profile, sometimes with their school uniform showing. He gets them from the photos I share in our family group chat. I've mentioned it twice casually and nothing changed. We've decided we don't want their photos online, so I'll stop posting them in the group and send them to him directly. I want him to take down the ones already up.
cases.reply: Dad, I love how proud you are of the kids, and I know the photos come from a good place. We've decided we don't want their pictures online, especially with the school visible. So I'm going to stop posting photos in the family group and send them to you directly, just for you. Could you take down the ones that are up now? Show them off on your phone as much as you like.
cases.note: The rule is about what you'll do with the photos, and there's one concrete ask. If he pushes back, repeat the same line shorter, with no new reasons.

cases.situation: 表弟小凯在北京实习，这半年已经来我家住了三次，每次一住就是一个多星期。我家一室一厅，我和女朋友住，很不方便。他说下个月还要来。我想以后不留他过夜，可以帮他在附近找家快捷酒店，第一天请他吃烤鸭。
cases.reply: 小凯，你来北京我挺高兴的，吃饭逛街随时叫我。跟你说一声，以后我这儿不留人过夜了，一室一厅两个人住已经挺挤。你下个月来，我帮你在我家附近找家快捷酒店，第一天晚上我请你吃烤鸭。
cases.note: 说成自己的规矩（不留人过夜），而不是说他添麻烦；他再磨，就把同一句话缩短了再说一遍。

cases.situation: Two weeks ago I told my mom I'm not hosting Christmas this year, after doing it five years running. Now my brother Mark has texted: 'Mom's really hurt, would it kill you to host one more time?' I'll still be there all day wherever it's held, bring dessert and help plan the menu.
cases.reply: I get that you're caught in the middle, Mark, and I know Mom's upset. I'm not hosting this year, and that part isn't changing. I'll be there all day wherever it ends up, and I'll bring dessert and help plan the menu.
cases.note: When others are recruited to push, repeat the same boundary with no new reasons, stay warm, and don't reopen it to win anyone back.

cases.situation: 我今年刚退休。女儿女婿都上班，想让我从下个月开始周一到周五全天去她家带两岁的外孙小满。我愿意帮忙，但天天全天带实在吃不消，我还报了老年大学周二周四的书法课。我能每周一、三、五白天带，周末也可以送来，周二周四可以一起看看托班或钟点工。
cases.reply: 闺女，我特别愿意帮你们带小满，能看着他长大我也高兴。不过周一到周五全天我身体顶不住，周二周四我还有书法课。我能做的是每周一、三、五白天过来带他，周末你们想出去也可以送来。周二周四怎么安排，咱们一起看看托班或者钟点工。
cases.note: 边界说成“我能做什么”，理由一句就够；她再劝，就重复“一三五我来”，不要加新理由。

cases.situation: A senior colleague, Greg, greets me with a hug most mornings and sometimes puts his hand on my shoulder in meetings. It feels friendly, not creepy, but I don't like being touched at work. I want to say something that sticks without making it a big deal; a wave or a handshake is fine with me.
cases.reply: Greg, I like working with you and I don't want this to be awkward. I'm not a hugger at work, so from now on I'll stick to a wave or a handshake. The morning hellos are still very much on.
cases.note: Say it once, lightly, and step back if a hug comes anyway. If it keeps happening after you've said it, take it to your manager or HR.

cases.situation: My ex-husband Dan and I share custody of our daughter Mia, who's 9. Lately he texts me late at night about his new job, his dating life and 'how we used to be'. I want to stay friendly for Mia's sake but only reply about her: school, pickups, health and plans, and he can call any time if something about her is urgent.
cases.reply: Dan, I think we co-parent Mia well, and I want to keep it that way. From now on I'm going to keep our messages to Mia: school, pickups, health and plans. I'll answer those promptly, and anything else I'll leave unanswered. If something about Mia is urgent, call me any time.
cases.note: The boundary is what you will reply to, not a rule for him. If he pushes, repeat it shorter: I'll keep it to Mia.

cases.situation: 我刚入职三个月，下周五部门聚餐。上次聚餐领导一桌桌劝酒，说“不喝就是不给面子”，我喝多了，第二天很难受。以后我不想喝酒了，想提前私下跟直属领导王姐说一声。
cases.reply: 王姐，下周五聚餐我一定到，挺期待跟大家一起吃饭的。先跟您说一声，我以后不喝酒了，上次喝完第二天状态很差。到时候我以茶代酒，敬酒、张罗都没问题。
cases.note: 说的是自己的做法（以茶代酒），理由一句就够；席上再被劝，就笑着重复“我不喝酒，以茶代酒敬您”，不加新理由。

cases.situation: Minha amiga Carla sempre chega uns 40 minutos atrasada, e às vezes desmarca meia hora antes. No último sábado fiquei sozinha no restaurante esperando por 50 minutos. Gosto muito dela e quero continuar saindo com ela. Decidi que, se ela atrasar mais de 20 minutos sem avisar, eu peço e começo sem ela, ou vou embora.
cases.reply: Carla, eu adoro nossos encontros e quero continuar tendo eles. Daqui pra frente, se você atrasar mais de 20 minutos sem avisar, eu vou pedir e começar sem você, ou vou embora, sem drama nenhum. Se o dia estiver corrido, é só me avisar e a gente remarca.
cases.note: O limite é o que você vai fazer, não uma cobrança sobre os atrasos. Se ela reclamar, repita a mesma frase, mais curta.

cases.situation: My coworker Tanya comments on my lunch almost every day ('salad again?', 'you've lost so much weight, what's your secret?'), sometimes in front of others. I don't want to discuss my food or my body at work at all. We otherwise get on well, and she's in the middle of renovating her kitchen.
cases.reply: Tanya, I really like our lunches together. I'm not going to talk about my food or my weight at work, so when it comes up I'll just change the subject. Now tell me, did the new cabinets for your kitchen finally arrive?
cases.note: If she tries again, repeat the same line and move on; do not explain why.

cases.situation: I'm a graphic designer. My friend Rob keeps asking for 'quick' free logo tweaks for his side business, and this is the fourth time this year. I want to keep the friendship, but from now on I'll quote for design work, and I'm happy to give him 20% off my usual rate.
cases.reply: Rob, I love seeing the business grow and I'm glad the logo is working for you. From now on I'm going to treat design work for friends like any other job, so I'll send you a quote for this one. As a friend you'll always get 20% off my usual rate.
cases.note: If he says 'it's only five minutes', repeat that you quote for all design work now; don't debate how long it takes.

cases.situation: 我是药剂师。舅舅每天在家族微信群里转发养生文章，还经常@我问“专家说的”对不对。上次我指出一篇是谣言，他在群里说我“读了几年书就瞧不起长辈”。我不想再在群里争了，但他真有用药问题我还是愿意帮。
cases.reply: 舅舅，您转这些说明您在乎身体，这我挺高兴的。以后群里的养生文章我就不点评了，您@我我也不在群里回。您自己吃药或者身体上有拿不准的，直接给我打电话，我好好跟您说。
cases.note: 说的是自己以后怎么做，不再辩文章对错；他再@你就照说的不回，私下的电话照样接。

cases.situation: 大学同学小林做保健品代理半年了，每周都私信给我推产品，上周又把我拉进了她的卖货群。我之前买过一次398元的，其实我本来就不吃保健品，以后不想再买了，但还想跟她做朋友，周末约她吃饭。那个卖货群我打算退了。
cases.reply: 小林，看你做得这么拼，挺佩服的。跟你说一声：保健品我以后就不买了，我本来也不吃这类东西，那个群我也先退了哈。你这个朋友我是一直要的，找个周末一起吃饭吧？
cases.note: 她再推产品时，只重复一句“保健品我不买，吃饭随时约”，不加新理由。

cases.situation: I'm a freelance bookkeeper. My client Sandra, who owns a hair salon, has started sending WhatsApp voice notes at 10 or 11pm and then again at 7am asking if I've seen them. I like working with her, and starting Monday 5 October I'm only answering client messages weekdays 9am to 5pm, within one working day.
cases.reply: Hi Sandra, I really enjoy working with you and the salon. Starting Monday 5 October, I'm answering client messages on weekdays between 9am and 5pm, and I'll reply to anything you send within one working day. Voice notes are still fine, I'll just pick them up in those hours. If you know a deadline is coming, tell me early and we'll plan around it.
cases.note: If a 7am follow-up still arrives, answer it at 9 without comment; the pattern sets the boundary.

cases.situation: 我正在办离婚，家里只告诉了我姐。结果她转头就跟我妈和小姨都说了，上周末小姨打电话来问我房子怎么分。我姐是我最亲的人，我不想跟她闹翻，但以后这件事告诉谁、说多少，我想自己决定，亲戚那边我自己去说。
cases.reply: 姐，这段时间你一直陪着我，我心里特别感激。离婚的事以后告诉谁、说多少，我想自己来决定，所以亲戚那边我会自己去说。有人问你，你就说让他们直接来问我。有什么进展，你还是我第一个打电话的人。
cases.note: 边界说的是自己以后怎么做，不翻她转述的旧账；她说“我是为你好”，就把同一句话缩短了再说一遍。

cases.situation: 好朋友阿雯做探店博主，每次约我吃饭都会拍我，从来不问。上周她把我素颜吃饭的视频发了出去，已经两万播放。我还想跟她一起探店，但不想再出现在她的视频里，也想让她把那条里有我的部分删掉。
cases.reply: 阿雯，跟你一起探店我一直挺开心的，也替你账号越做越好高兴。跟你说一声，以后我就不出镜了，你拍的时候我会先避开镜头。上周那条有我的，麻烦你删掉或者把我剪掉吧。下次探店照样叫我！
cases.note: 界限说成自己以后会怎么做，只提一个具体请求；她要是说“就几秒而已”，重复同一句，不加新理由。

cases.situation: 男朋友阿哲跟我在一起一年了，最近总趁我洗澡翻我手机里的微信聊天记录，昨天还追问我跟同事小王聊了什么。我没做任何对不起他的事，也不想分手，但不想再被翻手机。我已经把手机换了新密码。
cases.reply: 阿哲，我很在乎我们俩，所以想好好跟你说这件事。我的手机以后不会再让你翻了，我已经换了密码。这不是因为有什么要藏，而是我需要自己的空间。你要是有什么担心，直接问我，我都会认真回答你。
cases.note: 边界说成自己要做的事（换密码、不再给看），再给一个替代（直接问我）；对方再闹也只重复这一句。如果他因此发火、威胁你，或开始查你的位置和行踪，这已经是控制，找信任的人或专业机构谈谈；感到人身危险时立刻报警。

cases.situation: My son Liam is 26 and lives across town. He keeps borrowing my car at short notice, three times last month, and twice it came back nearly empty. I need it on weekdays for work. From now on I'll lend it on Sundays if he asks by Friday, and I want it back with a full tank.
cases.reply: Liam, I love that you still come to me when you need something, and I want to keep helping. From now on I'll lend you the car on Sundays, as long as you ask by Friday, and I'll need it back with a full tank. On weekdays I need it for work, so then the answer will be no. Love you.
cases.note: If he asks on a Tuesday, repeat it shorter: Sundays, ask by Friday. No new reasons.

cases.situation: At our Sunday family dinners my dad keeps making jokes about my wife Ana's Brazilian accent, imitating how she says certain words. Ana laughs it off at the table but has told me privately it hurts. I've decided that if it happens again, we'll leave early, and I want to tell him by text before this Sunday.
cases.reply: Dad, I love our Sunday dinners and I want them to keep happening. I'm not okay with the jokes about Ana's accent, so from now on, if one comes up, Ana and I will head home early. Everything else, we're glad to be there. See you Sunday.
cases.note: Say it calmly before the dinner, not during it. If a joke comes, leave quietly as promised; don't debate whether it was 'just a joke'.

cases.situation: 婆婆住在老家，每天晚上8点准时打微信视频要看孙子豆豆，可豆豆3岁，8点正是洗澡准备睡觉的时候，一视频就兴奋到十点才睡。老公也同意要改。我打算以后每周三、周六晚上7点主动打给她，其他晚上8点后不接视频，白天给她发照片和小视频。
cases.reply: 妈，您这么惦记豆豆，我们心里都暖暖的。跟您说一下，豆豆8点要洗澡睡觉，一视频就兴奋得睡不着，所以以后晚上8点后我就不接视频了。每周三、周六晚上7点我主动打给您，让豆豆好好跟奶奶聊；平时白天我多给您发照片和小视频。
cases.note: 说的是自己以后怎么做，再给一个固定的替代时间；她再在8点打来，就不接，第二天照常发照片，不加新理由。

cases.situation: My family WhatsApp group (my parents, my two sisters and their partners) sends 80 or more messages a day, and my sister Kate gets annoyed when I don't reply fast. I'm a nurse on 12-hour shifts. From now on I'm muting the group on shift days and catching up in the evening; if something's urgent, they can call me.
cases.reply: Love you all, and keep the photos coming. Quick heads-up: I'm going to mute this chat on my shift days and catch up in the evening, so don't worry if I'm quiet. If something's urgent, call me.
cases.note: In a group, say it once, lightly and to everyone; if Kate presses about a slow reply, repeat it shorter in a private message.

cases.situation: Since I moved back to my home town in August, my mum asks me every week to come to church with her on Sundays, and she leaves church leaflets in my car. I'm not religious and I'm not going to go weekly. I'm happy to go to the Christmas Eve service with her, and to keep our Sunday lunches after church.
cases.reply: Mum, I love being back near you, and I love our Sunday lunches. I'm not going to come to church on Sundays, so I'll stop discussing it, and any leaflets I find in the car I'll hand back to you. I'll happily come to the Christmas Eve service with you, and I'll see you for lunch after church every Sunday.
cases.note: If she asks again, repeat it shorter: Christmas Eve yes, Sundays no, lunch always. Don't debate belief.

cases.situation: My dad Ray picks up my kids, 6 and 9, from school on Fridays and drives them to his place. Last Friday I smelled alcohol on him when he dropped them back, and it happened once before in July. I love him and want the kids to keep seeing him, so from now on I'll do the school run myself and he's welcome at ours for Friday tea with them.
cases.reply: Dad, the kids love their Fridays with you, and I want that to carry on. From this Friday I'm going to pick them up from school myself, and they won't be getting in a car with anyone who's had a drink. Come round to ours for Friday tea with them instead; we'd love to have you.
cases.note: Keep the reason to one line and don't debate whether he'd been drinking; if you ever think a driver with children in the car is unsafe, call emergency services.

cases.situation: 我今年开始看心理咨询，每两周一次，状态在慢慢变好。我妈每次打电话都追问咨询师跟我聊了什么，上周还说要找咨询师的电话亲自问问。我不想跟她说咨询的内容，也不会给她咨询师的电话，但愿意跟她聊我最近的生活。这周日我回家吃饭。
cases.reply: 妈，我知道您是担心我，有您惦记着，我心里挺暖的。咨询里聊的内容我不打算说，您问起来我就换个话题，咨询师的电话我也不会给。我最近状态在慢慢变好，周日回家吃饭，跟您好好聊聊我最近的日子。
cases.note: 边界说成自己会怎么做；她再追问，就重复“咨询的事我不聊”，不加理由。情绪变糟或有伤害自己的念头时，及时联系咨询师或当地心理援助热线，有危险直接打急救电话。

cases.situation: Mein Freund Jonas erzählt seiner Mutter Heike von unseren Streits, und beim Sonntagskaffee spricht sie mich dann darauf an, zuletzt auf unseren Streit wegen des Urlaubs. Ich liebe ihn und mag Heike, aber über unsere Beziehung will ich mit ihr nicht mehr reden. Wenn ihn etwas stört, möchte ich es zuerst von ihm hören.
cases.reply: Jonas, ich bin so gern mit dir zusammen, und ich mag deine Mutter wirklich. Über unsere Streits rede ich mit Heike ab jetzt nicht mehr: Wenn sie mich darauf anspricht, sage ich, dass das zwischen dir und mir bleibt, und wechsle das Thema. Wenn dich etwas stört, will ich es zuerst von dir hören.
cases.note: Die Grenze beschreibt, was du tust, nicht was er tun muss; fragt er nach, dieselbe Aussage kürzer wiederholen.

cases.situation: I'm 22 and in my final year at uni in another city. My mum has had my location shared to her phone since I was 16, and she texts when she sees me somewhere unexpected, like 'why are you at a bar on a Tuesday?'. I'm turning location sharing off this weekend; I'll text her whenever I'm travelling home, and we'll keep our Sunday calls.
cases.reply: Mum, I know the location sharing started because you love me and wanted me safe. I'm 22 now, so I'm turning it off this weekend. I'll text you whenever I'm travelling home, and we've still got our Sunday calls.
cases.note: Say what you'll do and what she still gets; don't debate the bar on a Tuesday. If she pushes, repeat it shorter.

cases.situation: I've been sober for eight months. My brother Sam hosts a family barbecue next Saturday, and at the last two he kept offering me a beer, saying 'just one won't hurt'. I love him and want to go; I'll bring my own drinks, and if the offers keep coming I'll head home early.
cases.reply: Sam, I'm looking forward to Saturday and I want to keep coming to these. I'm not drinking, so I'll bring my own drinks and say no to any beer, once. If the offers keep coming, I'll head home early. Save me a burger.
cases.note: Don't explain or defend your sobriety; if the pressure gets hard, lean on whoever supports your recovery, and leaving early is always allowed.

cases.situation: My uncle Pete sends me political videos on WhatsApp most days and starts debates about the election at family dinners. We vote differently and I'm tired of arguing. From now on I won't reply to political messages or discuss politics at dinner, but I love fishing with him and we've got a trip planned for Saturday 17 October.
cases.reply: Pete, you're one of my favourite people, and I don't want politics getting between us. From now on I'm not going to reply to political videos or talk about the election at dinner; if it comes up, I'll change the subject. Everything else, I'm all yours, especially fishing. Still on for Saturday the 17th?
cases.note: If another video arrives, leave it unanswered and reply to his next non-political message as normal; don't debate the boundary itself.

cases.situation: Since my breakup with Tom in June, my best friend Aisha keeps telling me news about him and sending me screenshots of his posts with his new girlfriend. I asked her lightly once to stop and it's still happening. From now on I won't open anything about Tom and I'll change the subject if he comes up, but I love our Friday wine nights.
cases.reply: Aisha, I love you, and our Friday wine nights are the best part of my week. I'm not going to hear news about Tom anymore, so if he comes up I'll change the subject, and I'll leave any screenshots of him unopened. Everything else, I want to hear all of it.
cases.note: If she says she thought you'd want to know, repeat it shorter: no Tom news. No new reasons.

cases.situation: Hago voluntariado en el banco de alimentos de mi barrio los sábados por la mañana. La coordinadora, Marta, me pide casi cada semana que cubra turnos extra entre semana, y este mes ya he dicho que sí cuatro veces aunque trabajo a jornada completa. Quiero seguir con mis sábados y dejar de cubrir turnos entre semana; puedo ofrecerme a formar a los voluntarios nuevos un sábado al mes.
cases.reply: Marta, me encanta venir los sábados y quiero seguir haciéndolo mucho tiempo. A partir de ahora no voy a cubrir turnos entre semana, porque con el trabajo a jornada completa no me da. Lo que sí puedo hacer es formar a los voluntarios nuevos un sábado al mes. ¡Nos vemos el sábado!
cases.note: Si vuelve a pedírtelo, repite la misma frase más corta: entre semana no, los sábados sí. Sin razones nuevas.

cases.situation: 我们五个大学同学每个月聚一次，因为我有车，每次都默认我开车、不能喝酒，散场还要绕路把大家一个个送回家，到家常常过了一点。我还想继续参加，但以后不再每次都开车了：一年开两三次，其余时候跟大家一样打车，也能喝两杯，轮到我开的那次提前在群里说。
cases.reply: 跟大家说个事～每个月的聚会我特别珍惜，会一直来。以后我就不每次都开车了，一年里我开两三次，其他时候跟大家一样打车，也陪你们喝两杯。哪次轮到我开，我提前在群里说。
cases.note: 说的是自己以后怎么做，不翻绕路送人的旧账；有人说“你就顺便嘛”，重复同一句，不加新理由。
